limitations: Sequential isolated child processes; deadlines and Node heap budgets are recorded and failures/timeouts remain explicit.

Native-room IFC export is enabled by this comparison tool by default; ordinary Reviter export defaults remain independent.

Fresh Reviter conversions use the unchanged upstream IFCs from a previous independently reopened run; input/binary/output hashes and mode/walker settings are verified and recorded. Reopens/reference joins do not reconvert RVT.
